description: Defines a Flutter widget 'DiceWidget' that displays a dice icon and a button to roll the dice, integrating with the 'BoardProvider' for state management.

classes.name: DiceWidget
classes.description: A StatelessWidget that displays the last rolled dice and a button to roll the dice, with dynamic styling based on whether dice can be rolled.

methods.name: _diceIcon
methods.description: Returns the appropriate icon for the provided dice value (1-6), or a help icon for invalid values.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree, displaying the dice and roll button with functionality tied to the BoardProvider.
